svg.text: #587 Enterprise GraphRAG (LazyGraphRAG/LightRAG) vs. Hybrid Vector RAG vs. 128K Long Context
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Cut Graph Indexing Cost by 94% ($2,700 vs. $45,000) · 75/20/5 Query Intent Router
1. Solving the $45,000 GraphRAG Indexing Cost Trap
✕ Naive Full-LLM GraphRAG Indexing (50M Corpus Tokens)
• Calls 70B LLM on every 600-tok chunk + multi-gleaning + Leiden summaries
• 5.6x Token Amplification = 280M LLM Tokens → $45,000 per index rebuild!
• Daily document updates become prohibitively expensive
✓ LazyGraphRAG + LightRAG Incremental Entity Graph (-94% Index Cost)
• Step 1: Extract Entities & Noun-Phrase Co-occurrence via GLiNER/NLP on L40S
• Step 2: Defer LLM Community Summarization to Query-Time (Lazy Evaluation)
• Step 3: LightRAG Incremental Subgraph Append (Zero full-graph Leiden rebuild)
• Indexing Cost for 50M Tokens: $2,700 (vs. $45,000) · Global Sensemaking: 91.8%
2. Production 75 / 20 / 5 Query Intent Routing Matrix
Route A (75% Queries): Single-Hop Fact & Clause Lookup → Hybrid Vector+BM25
• Dense HNSW + BM25 RRF + BGE Reranker Top-5 · Latency: 220ms · Cost: $0.003/query
• Fact QA Accuracy: 94.2% (Graph traversal adds zero value here — don't waste tokens!)
Route B (20% Queries): Multi-Hop Supply Chain & Global Theme → LazyGraphRAG
• 2-Hop Subgraph Expansion + Dynamic Community Map-Reduce · Cost: $0.018/query
• Global / 3-Hop Accuracy: 91.8% (vs. 42.5% on Pure Vector RAG — +49.3 pts lift!)
Route C (5% Queries): Bounded Deal Room (<=15 Docs / <120K Tok) → 128K Direct
• Stuff full contract bundle into 128K Prefix Cache · Zero chunking loss · Acc: 95.6%
• Never use 128K stuffing across >500 docs (attention dilution + $0.18/query cost)
3. Blended Enterprise Knowledge Platform ROI (1M Queries/Month · 50M Token Corpus)
• Routing 75% to Hybrid Vector ($0.003), 20% to LazyGraphRAG ($0.018), and 5% to 128K Prefix Stuffing ($0.025) yields $7,100/mo query cost.
• Achieves 93.8% overall accuracy across both pinpoint facts and multi-hop risk cascades at 84.2% lower TCO than all-GraphRAG.
